# Resonance Coherence — AI Reader Guide

This site is the organizational spine for Resonance Coherent Holdings, LLC.
It introduces the mission, open research corpus, live and in-build systems,
Earth Resonance Network, and public governance commitments.

Canonical site URL:
https://resonancecoherence.org/

Primary public profiles:
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/ResonanceAdmin
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0002-7140-8516
- Zenodo community: https://zenodo.org/communities/resonance-coherence/records?q=&l=list&p=1&s=10&sort=newest

Research corpus:
- Repository: https://github.com/ResonanceAdmin/resonance-coherence-papers
- AI guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ResonanceAdmin/resonance-coherence-papers/main/llms.txt
- Manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ResonanceAdmin/resonance-coherence-papers/main/manifest.json

Canonical reading order for site pages:
1. Home: https://resonancecoherence.org/
2. Mission: https://resonancecoherence.org/mission.html
3. Research: https://resonancecoherence.org/research.html
4. Systems: https://resonancecoherence.org/systems.html
5. Earth Resonance Network: https://resonancecoherence.org/network.html
6. Governance: https://resonancecoherence.org/governance.html
7. Contact: https://resonancecoherence.org/contact.html

Key boundary:
Published research and public site content are open under CC-BY-4.0 unless
otherwise noted. Instrument computation methodology, personal data, and
pre-publication work remain protected according to the Open Science and
Independence policies.
